name.it: Dichiarazione più copiosa della dottrina cristiana
name.en-US: An Ample Declaration of the Christian Doctrine
name.pt-BR: Declaração mais ampla da doutrina cristã

description.it: Dottrina cristiana in forma di dialogo tra maestro e discepolo: il Credo, il Padre nostro, l'Ave Maria, i comandamenti, i sacramenti, le virtù, i peccati e i novissimi (1598). Testo dell'edizione Vivès (1870-74), da scansione OCR.
description.en-US: The longer catechism in dialogue form: the Creed, the Our Father, the Hail Mary, the commandments, the sacraments, the virtues, sins and the last things (1598). The Italian is the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan; the English is Richard Hadock's translation of 1604 (EEBO-TCP), in the spelling of its time.
description.pt-BR: O catecismo maior em forma de diálogo entre mestre e discípulo: Credo, Pai-nosso, Ave-Maria, mandamentos, sacramentos, virtudes, pecados e novíssimos (1598).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 12 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain. Italian.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.

sources.edition: An ample declaration of the Christian doctrine, trans. Richard Hadock (Douai?, 1604), EEBO-TCP A07972.
sources.description: Keyed transcription (CC0) in early-modern spelling; long s normalised, marginal notes dropped; the chapters follow the Italian, the English merging two of them where the Italian heading was not read.
sources.tierEvidence: Printed 1604; EEBO-TCP text released into the public domain (CC0).
